map.物体所受地球引力。: The gravitational pull acting on an object.
map.重力 W = 质量 m × 重力加速度 g；标准重力 g = 9.80665 m: Weight W = mass m × gravitational acceleration g; standard gravity g = 9.80665 m/s², with 9.81 m/s² common in engineering; to convert to kilogram-force, W(kgf) = W(N) ÷ 9.80665; surface gravity on the Moon is about 1/6 of Earth's and on Mars about 38%.

map.质量和重量一样吗？: Are mass and weight the same?
map.不一样：质量是物质量（kg，不变），重量是重力（N，随地 g 变）。结果按标准力: No — mass is the amount of matter (kg, unchanged), while weight is the gravitational force (N, varying with local g).
